data.label: Resident registry
data.holds: Name, birth date, address, contact, PhilSys last four, household membership.

data.label: Protection sectors
data.holds: Whether a resident is recorded as a VAWC survivor or a child in conflict with the law.

data.label: Household record
data.holds: Address, members, and the vulnerability indicators read from them.

data.label: Case notes
data.holds: What a worker recorded about a family, including protected notes.

data.label: Assistance requests
data.holds: Who asked for what, the assessment, and the decision.

data.label: Supporting documents
data.holds: Scans an applicant presented, which routinely include medical abstracts.

data.label: Releases
data.holds: Who was paid what, when and where.

data.label: Referrals
data.holds: Why a client was sent to another office, and what was disclosed to them.

data.label: Programme catalogue
data.holds: Eligibility guidance, requirements and responsibility. About no person.

data.label: Audit trail
data.holds: Who accessed or changed which record, and when.
